tasks.label: proxyenv: rust debug build
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $debugTemp='${workspaceFolder}\.debug-tmp'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $debugTemp | Out-Null; $env:TEMP=$debugTemp; $env:TMP=$debugTemp; Import-Module 'D:\VisualStudio\BuildTools\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath 'D:\VisualStudio\BuildTools' -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64'; $env:CARGO_HOME='D:\Rust\cargo'; $env:RUSTUP_HOME='D:\Rust\rustup'; $env:Path='D:\Rust\cargo\bin;' + $env:Path; & 'D:\Rust\cargo\bin\cargo.exe' build --manifest-path '${workspaceFolder}\src-tauri\Cargo.toml' --target-dir '${workspaceFolder}\.cargo-target'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
